purpose: Optional grocery environment theme; characters and product assets preserved

assets.name: gondola
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: attached existing empty supermarket fixture. Create a production-ready replacement transparent game sprite of THIS SAME fixture with IDENTICAL front-elevated orthographic camera, bounding proportions, shelf heights, alignment, zero perspective rotation. Two wide empty display shelf tiers. Cream uprights, pale sage green shelf edges, honey oak backpanel. Preserve exact two shelf levels and camera geometry. Art direction: cozy 2D illustrated life-sim, clean gently rounded silhouettes, thick consistent warm dark cocoa brown outlines (not black), broad flat pastel color areas, only one simple cel shadow color. Hand-drawn cartoon furniture at small mobile-game scale. Remove all photo texture, wood grain noise, gradients, metallic highlights and fussy line details. Clear matte flat color fills. No characters, no groceries, no items, no text, no backdrop, no ground plane. Transparent alpha outside the object; fit whole object, tiny even padding. Existing separately rendered product images must line up on the same shelf top edges.

assets.name: checkout
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Attached image is the exact game checkout fixture to restyle. Keep its tall narrow shape, almost topdown front view, footprint, screen at TOP, conveyor belt below, all component positions and proportions. Draw as clean cozy 2D cartoon game furniture with thick smooth cocoa-brown outlines, flat pale cream main surface, sage green outer rim and drawer, warm brown cash register, muted slate blue conveyor, pale blue screens.
